inputs.description: 請輸入 Job 目錄路徑：

tasks.label: AIVideo: 🌐 啟動 Streamlit 說書人網頁控制台 (Port 8501)

windows.command: docker ps -q --filter 'publish=8501' | ForEach-Object { docker rm -f $_ }; docker compose run --rm -p 8501:8501 pipeline streamlit run aivideo/webui.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0

tasks.label: AIVideo: 🛑 停止 Streamlit 網頁控制台 (釋放 8501 埠)

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo check
docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo check --gemini
docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo images --job ${input:jobPath}

tasks.label: AIVideo: 批次生成語音 (aivideo tts)

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo tts --job ${input:jobPath}

tasks.label: AIVideo: 🔄 重新生成語音並合成影片 (TTS -> 成片 -> 預覽)
tasks.command: aivideo tts --job ${input:jobPath} --force; aivideo compose --job ${input:jobPath}; aivideo preview --job ${input:jobPath}

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo tts --job ${input:jobPath} --force; docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo compose --job ${input:jobPath}; docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo preview --job ${input:jobPath}

tasks.label: AIVideo: 🎨 重新生圖並合成影片 (Images -> 成片 -> 預覽)
tasks.command: aivideo images --job ${input:jobPath} --force; aivideo compose --job ${input:jobPath}; aivideo preview --job ${input:jobPath}

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo images --job ${input:jobPath} --force; docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo compose --job ${input:jobPath}; docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo preview --job ${input:jobPath}

tasks.label: AIVideo: 🚀 全流程重新生成 (生圖 + 語音 + 成片 + 預覽)
tasks.command: aivideo images --job ${input:jobPath} --force; aivideo tts --job ${input:jobPath} --force; aivideo compose --job ${input:jobPath}; aivideo preview --job ${input:jobPath}

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo images --job ${input:jobPath} --force; docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo tts --job ${input:jobPath} --force; docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo compose --job ${input:jobPath}; docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo preview --job ${input:jobPath}
docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo srt --job ${input:jobPath}

tasks.label: AIVideo: 合成 1080p 影片 (aivideo compose)

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo compose --job ${input:jobPath}

tasks.label: AIVideo: 產生故事板預覽頁 (aivideo preview)

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo preview --job ${input:jobPath}

tasks.label: AIVideo: 列出音色角色庫 (aivideo voices)

windows.command: docker compose run --rm pipeline python -m aivideo voices

tasks.label: AIVideo: 啟動 ComfyUI 服務 (GPU)
